response.text: The EMEA revenue for Q3 was $28.7 million. Rounding it up to the nearest ten million would result in $30 million. However, $30 million exceeds the reported figure by more than 3% (3% of $28.7 million is approximately $0.86 million, making the maximum allowable rounded figure about $29.56 million). Therefore, rounding up to $30 million would overstate the figure by too much. For accuracy, the figure as reported—$28.7 million—is used.
